events.factual_description: Smoke Jazz Club presents Larry Goldings, Peter Bernstein, and Bill Stewart from August 19 through August 23, 2026 to celebrate the release of Rhombus, issued by Smoke Sessions Records on August 7. The trio has performed and recorded together for more than 35 years. Smoke lists 6:30 PM and 8:30 PM dinner shows on all five dates, with additional 10:00 PM shows on Friday August 21 and Saturday August 22. Smoke Sessions notes that the trio first played together at Augie's Jazz Bar, the room that is now Smoke Jazz Club.

en.why_it_matters: This clears S because the context makes a great working trio unusually specific. Goldings, Bernstein and Stewart have spent more than 35 years turning Hammond B-3, guitar and drums into a single conversational instrument, with groove and instantaneous interplay at the center. Rhombus is new music from that living language, and releasing it at Smoke carries extra weight because this is the same room lineage where the trio first developed at Augie's. The venue is part of the story, not merely a tour stop.
en.trip_verdict: S. Worth a dedicated DMV-to-New York trip for one of the remaining sets if the timing works, especially because the record-release residency returns the trio to the room lineage where its chemistry began. It stays below S+ because this is a five-night residency by an active trio rather than a one-off, farewell, or singular historical reunion.

es.why_it_matters: Esto llega a S porque el contexto vuelve especialmente concreta a una gran banda de trabajo. Goldings, Bernstein y Stewart llevan más de 35 años convirtiendo Hammond B-3, guitarra y batería en un solo instrumento conversacional, con groove e interacción instantánea en el centro. Rhombus es música nueva nacida de ese lenguaje vivo, y presentarla en Smoke pesa todavía más porque es la misma genealogía de sala donde el trío empezó a desarrollarse en Augie's. El venue es parte de la historia, no una simple parada de gira.
es.trip_verdict: S.
